name: VTK-Based Transfer Function Application
definition: A method for applying color and opacity transfer functions using VTK classes (`vtkLookupTable` and `vtkPiecewiseFunction`) to map scalar values to RGBA components.
summary: This VTK-specific method maps scalar values to RGBA properties using a pre-computed color lookup table and piecewise opacity function, differing from shader-based approaches by relying on VTK's internal interpolation.
